capabilities: Sync the vault across desktop, mobile and browsers with end-to-end encryption
Collaborate live on a shared note with real-time cursors
Share whole vaults or single notes as links
Restore notes from version history and trash
extras: Freemium: 14-day free trial, then a paid plan is required. The server is closed source (plugin is MIT); a self-hosted server is planned. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer. Currently installed via BRAT. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns to keep your own backup and that a lost passphrase means lost data.
problem: Keeping an Obsidian vault in sync across devices usually means trusting a server with plaintext or juggling third-party storage; this offers device-side encryption where the server only stores ciphertext.

requires.name: Paid plan after the free 14-day trial

summary: End-to-end encrypted vault sync service that keeps notes in sync across desktop, mobile and any browser, with live collaboration and version history.
